title: Guest Towel Holder Countertop Stand 16.3-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection, Freestanding Towel Stand | Sea Foam Green | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient towel storage at the sink with this guest towel holder for the bathroom countertop in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. This freestanding towel stand features two arms to hold guest towels, hand towels, and washcloths close to the vanity area. Crafted from solid brass, it uses a heavy base to help reduce tipping and includes a felt pad to help protect countertop surfaces.

Highlights:
- Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction
- Heavy base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on the counter
- Part of the carolina collection to coordinate with matching pieces

Specs:
- Mounting type: Countertop (freestanding)
- Dimensions: 16.3-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Freestanding towel holder
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

A smart fit for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
